entities.summary: Wenzel Trnka von Krzowitz was an Austrian-Czech physician, professor, and amateur composer of the 18th century. He is thought to have composed the canons Bei der Hitz im Sommer eß ich and Leck mir den Arsch fein recht schön sauber, which were previously attributed to Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart.
